title: Pest Control Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control inspection, monitoring, exclusion, treatment, and follow-up through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete pest control equipment inspection report for treatment zones, devices, products, and pest observations. It connects approved pest plan, product label, and site authorization to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified pest-management technician must inspect treatment zones, devices, products, and pest observations against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Pest Control inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Current product labeling is available before product handling or use
Applicator credential and assignment are appropriate to the planned task
Sensitive occupants, children, pets, food, feed, and medical concerns identified
Treatment, buffer, exclusion, and restricted-entry boundaries defined
Weather, ventilation, runoff, pollinator, and water conditions checked
Required PPE, first-aid information, spill kit, and emergency contact available
Product, EPA registration, lot, mix, rate, amount, and device identity traceable
Food-contact surfaces, utensils, toys, bedding, and personal items protected
Warning, notification, reentry, aeration, and cleanup instructions assigned
Unused product, rinsate, container, carcass, and contaminated material controlled

sections.title: Pest Control equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This pest control equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when target identification, product labeling, applicator qualification, occupant protection, weather, exposure, spill, or treatment boundary is uncertain. A pest-management compliance supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted
blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated outcome; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
